integrity: Exact integer determinant-cycle certificate, fully constructive support and primitive period proofs, and independent brute-force composition checks through length sixteen.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary contiguous binary palindromes of exactly length four, cyclic periodic extension; not general palindrome avoidance or Watson-Crick complement. Related literature examined but historical priority is not independently established.
title: Weight-refined periodic-orbit census for binary four-palindrome avoidance
